author: Cinna Davis (with OpenAI Codex assistance)
statement: The u=1 tapered witness has a prescribed two-packet realization per copy over Z_(2), with M=2hL ports and degree 2L-1.
remaining_obligations: Realize matching h=Theta(M) with bounded-degree tensors and a valid packing, or prove an obstruction.
Determine whether an odd-normalized witness has a Boolean realization.
